# @mission-platform/mcp-developer

Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that helps AI assistants develop inside the
Mission Platform monorepo. No runtime dependencies; compiled via Turborepo and
run from its built output on Node.js 24+ (`node mcp/developer/dist/index.js`).
Speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio.

## What it is for

Give an AI assistant grounded, repo-specific help with core workflows:

1. Component usage — discover components (with atomic level), props, Vue/React imports.
2. Atomic component design — atoms/molecules/organisms/templates/pages + story titles.
3. Composable / store / util authoring — nested `src/<kind>/<name>/` + required tests.
4. Package creation — scaffold a convention-compliant `packages/<name>`.
5. Package development — layout, public API, build/test/lint, changesets.
6. App creation — scaffold a `apps/<name>` Vite + Vue 3 app.
7. App development — compose packages; deploy via Cloudflare/forge-spa.
8. Worker creation — scaffold a `workers/<name>` Cloudflare Worker.
9. Worker development — typed `fetch` handler; keep workers thin.

## Capabilities

- Tools: `get_guide`, `list_docs`, `read_doc`, `search_docs`, `list_components`,
  `get_component_usage`, `list_packages`, `list_apps`, `list_workers`,
  `get_member_info`, `scaffold_package`, `scaffold_app`, `scaffold_worker`,
  `scaffold_crate`, `scaffold_component`, `scaffold_composable`, `scaffold_store`,
  `scaffold_util`, `list_locales`, `add_locale`, `remove_locale`,
  `update_translation`.
- Resources: `mission://guide/<id>`, `mission://inventory`, `mission://docs/<slug>`.
- Prompts: `use-component`, `create-package`, `develop-package`, `create-app`,
  `develop-app`, `create-worker`, `develop-worker`.

## Safety

All repo inspection is read-only. Scaffolding tools and the i18n locale tools
(`add_locale`, `remove_locale`, `update_translation`) are dry-run unless
`apply: true`; scaffolding never overwrites existing files/folders.

## Run

```bash
pnpm exec turbo run build --filter @mission-platform/mcp-*
node mcp/developer/dist/index.js
pnpm --dir mcp/developer test
```
